explanations.trigger_explanation: Crossing district canals, siphons, ditches, pipes, or easements with a utility line commonly triggers the district canal crossing request and district technical conditions.

known_unknowns: Board-approved terms and technical conditions vary by crossing type and, for pipelines, the conveyed substance.
advisories: Additional review recommended for any project that touches district-owned canals or easements because district-specific protective conditions can be stricter than general utility practice.
notes: Confidence tier 2 because the district publishes an official canal crossing policy and request form, but final conditions are district-specific and case-based.
